facts.scope_summary: Implementation of SAP Cloud ALM for Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management aligned with the S/4 RISE migration plan. Scope includes Cloud ALM tenant setup, ChaRM workflow configuration, monitoring and alerting use cases, dashboards, and transition/hypercare support.
in_scope: SAP Cloud ALM Standard Change Management
Dev & QA change cycle end-to-end testing
Production system mapping in ChaRM workflow
SAP Landscape management, Data flow configuration to CALM
User Management in SAP Cloud ALM Tenant
assumptions: SAP Cloud ALM subscription is a prerequisite.
Technical team onboarding is a prerequisite.
Identification of customer landscape including SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP apps, and MII is required.
Integration technologies used (CPI, Integration Suite) must be identified.
User/Role matrix for Cloud ALM is a prerequisite.
Finalized monitoring use cases are a prerequisite.
Train the Trainer workshop plan & readiness is a prerequisite.
Key roles personas mapping for authorization testing is a prerequisite.
Current Project Team support/alignment is a prerequisite.
Successful go live of all the landscapes is a prerequisite for deploy/hypercare.
Cutover readiness for transport migration is a prerequisite.
Transition plan & stakeholders and METRO team alignment for transition are prerequisites.
